dialog.createdDescription: Add agents, logins and integrations to it.
dialog.description: A separate space for a client, project or area of your life — with its own agents, logins, 2FA codes and integrations.
dialog.clickIcon: Click the icon to change it
dialog.namePlaceholder: e.g. ACME Corp, Side project, Household
dialog.descriptionPlaceholder: What happens in this workspace? Agents see this as context.
dialog.agentContextHint: Given to every agent in this workspace on every run.
dialog.contextExample:
We are ACME GmbH. Write to clients in German.
Invoices go to finance@acme.example.
Never touch the production database.
dialog.sourcesHint: Every agent in this workspace can read and edit these and follows their CLAUDE.md. Repositories are cloned for them.
dialog.autoMergeHint: When an agent delivers a ticket with a pull request, Godmode merges it into its base branch and moves the ticket to Done — no approval needed.
dialog.vmNone: None — agents work on this Mac
dialog.vmHint: The workspace's agents work in this macOS VM, unless an agent or a chat has its own.

sources.emptyHint: Give every agent here the files it needs — a project folder on this computer, or a git repository Godmode clones for them.
sources.pickerTitle: Add a folder to the workspace
sources.pickerDescription: Every agent in this workspace can read and edit the files in it. Their chats keep working in their own folder.
sources.clonesOnSave: Godmode clones it when you save.
sources.notCloned: Not cloned yet — it's cloned before the next run.
sources.privateHint: Private repositories use this computer's git sign-in — an SSH key for <mono>git@</mono> URLs, or a credential helper such as <mono>gh auth login</mono>.

scope.grantNest: Confirm to hand {{from}}'s logins, 2FA codes and cards to {{to}}'s agents.
scope.grantProject: Confirm to let runs in {{name}}, whose context an agent wrote, read secrets again.
scope.grantUndo: Confirm to give the logins, 2FA codes and cards back.
scope.dropProject: Drop on a workspace, or make it one

nest.title: Move {{name}} into {{to}}?
nest.description: {{name}} becomes a project of {{to}}. You can undo it right after.
nest.movesAlong: Its agents, chats, tasks and repositories move along.
nest.projects_one: Its project becomes a project of {{to}} too.
nest.projects_other: Its {{count}} projects become projects of {{to}} too.
nest.secrets: Its logins, 2FA codes, integrations and browser profiles become {{to}}'s, shared with every agent there.
nest.settings: {{to}}'s VM and auto-merge settings apply to it from then on.

review.title: Make {{name}} a workspace?
review.description: An agent wrote this project's context. As the workspace's, every agent there follows it, so read it first.

page.title: Workspaces
page.description: Separate clients, projects or areas of your life. Each workspace has its own agents, logins, 2FA codes and integrations — global items are shared with all of them.
page.noMatchHint: Try another name, or create it.
page.globalDescription: Logins, 2FA codes, integrations and agents here are available everywhere — perfect for your personal accounts and the main Godmode assistant.
page.firstHint: e.g. one per client — agents there only see that client's logins.
page.dragHint: Drag a project onto another workspace, or out to make it a workspace. Drag a workspace onto another to nest it.

deleteDialog.title: Delete {{icon}} {{name}}?
deleteDialog.description: This can't be undone. Global items and other workspaces are not affected.

forceDialog.title: {{name}} isn't empty
forceDialog.description: Force delete removes the workspace together with everything that belongs to it:
forceDialog.tip: Tip: move items you want to keep to Global or another workspace first.
